test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: At the inauguration of 'Tech NEEV @ 75' in November 2021, Union Minister of State for Science and Technology, Jitendra Singh announced the setting up of 30 STI Hubs in different parts of the country for Scheduled Tribes (STs) by the end of 2022. STI stands for ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **STI Hubs are being set up to promote scientific talent among Scheduled Tribes (STs).**
 
• The initiative aims to establish 30 STI Hubs by the end of 2022 for overall socio-economic development.
 
• **Out of 75 proposed STI Hubs for SCs/STs, 20 have already been set up, benefiting about 20,000 people.**
 
• The focus of these hubs is on sustainable development through scientific interventions in agriculture, non-farm sectors, and livelihoods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **STI (Science, Technology, and Innovation):** Refers to the use of scientific knowledge and technological innovations to address societal challenges and improve socio-economic conditions.
 
• **Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas:** Celebrated on the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda to honor the contributions of tribal communities to India's development.
 
• **Global Innovation Index (GII):** A ranking that measures a country's innovation performance. India ranked 46th in 2021, showing significant progress due to investment in R&D and scientific output.
 
• **Vocal for Local:** A concept that emphasizes the importance of developing technology and solutions that cater to local needs while promoting indigenous talent.
